llm.reason: Chord diagrams effectively display weighted many-to-many relationships like border lengths between countries in a compact, readable circular layout.

ranking.note: Compact circular layout clearly displays weighted many-to-many relationships like border lengths between ~169 countries.
Good for showing network topology and clusters, but precise edge weights are harder to read than chord widths.
